edits.before_source:
name: Migration gates (Linux)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "workers-ts/**"
      - "view/common/**"
      - "view/shared/**"
      - "view/admin-ts/**"
      - "view/pc-ts/**"
      - "view/supplier-ts/**"
      - "view/kefu-ts/**"
      - "view/uniapp-ts/**"
      - ".gitleaks.toml"
      - ".gitattributes"
      - ".github/workflows/workers-runtime-linux.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "workers-ts/**"
      - "view/common/**"
      - "view/shared/**"
      - "view/admin-ts/**"
      - "view/pc-ts/**"
      - "view/supplier-ts/**"
      - "view/kefu-ts/**"
      - "view/uniapp-ts/**"
      - ".gitleaks.toml"
      - ".gitattributes"
      - ".github/workflows/workers-runtime-linux.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: workers-runtime-linux-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Preserve the existing required-check name and fail closed on either dependency.
  worker-static:
    name: Worker type, unit, schema and route gates
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [worker-unit, worker-catalog]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Require both unchanged gate groups to succeed
        env:
          UNIT_RESULT: ${{ needs.worker-unit.result }}
          CATALOG_RESULT: ${{ needs.worker-catalog.result }}
        run: |
          test "$UNIT_RESULT" = "success"
          test "$CATALOG_RESULT" = "success"

  worker-unit:
    name: Worker type, unit, schema and route execution (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Run 39218895760 still recorded passing native cases at the 90-minute
    # job limit (9,197 case passes, no reported assertion failures). Preserve
    # both shards, per-test deadlines and exact zero-skip coverage checks.
    timeout-minutes: 120
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16.14-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: finance_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance_test
          POSTGRES_DB: cinashop_finance_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U finance_test -d cinashop_finance_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      TEST_FINANCE_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://finance_test:finance_test@127.0.0.1:5432/cinashop_finance_test
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Audit production dependencies
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run audit:prod

      # The unit suite bundles real Admin/Supplier auth and Axios code. Frontend
      # build jobs have separate filesystems; both unit shards need each lockfile.
      - name: Install locked Admin dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/admin-ts

      - name: Install locked Supplier dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/supplier-ts

      - name: Install locked Kefu dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/kefu-ts

      - name: Install locked Uni dependencies for customer SFC unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/uniapp-ts

      - name: Run both TypeScript configurations
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Begin isolated native child diagnostic capture
        run: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/audit-native-child-diagnostics.ts --begin

      - name: Run Worker unit tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npm run test:unit -- --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/2 --reporter=verbose --reporter=json --outputFile.json=unit-shard-results.json 2>&1 | tee unit-shard.log

      - name: Audit native child diagnostics including incomplete failed runs
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/audit-native-child-diagnostics.ts

      - name: Preserve unit shard diagnostics even on failure
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: unit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.sha }}
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            workers-ts/unit-shard-results.json
            workers-ts/unit-shard.log
            workers-ts/.cache/native-child-diagnostics/published-*/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Verify exact executed unit shard coverage
        run: node scripts/audit-unit-shards.mjs ${{ matrix.shard }} unit-shard-results.json

      - name: Audit production observability contract
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run audit:observability

      - name: Audit legacy-to-PostgreSQL schema drift
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: |
          npx --no-install tsx scripts/mysql-to-postgres.ts schema-audit --json |
            node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify({source:r.coverage.sourceTableCount,target:r.coverage.targetTableCount,shared:r.coverage.sharedTableCount,sourceGaps:r.coverage.sourceColumnGapTableCount,externalOnly:r.definitionDrift.externalOnlyTables.length,workerOnly:r.definitionDrift.workerOnlyTables.length,columnDrift:r.definitionDrift.columnDrift.length}));})'

      - name: Audit legacy-to-Worker route parity
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: |
          npx --no-install tsx scripts/route-parity-audit.ts |
            node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify({authority:r.phpRoot,...r.totals}));})'

  worker-catalog:
    name: Isolated PostgreSQL 16 migration catalog execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16.14-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: finance_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance_test
          POSTGRES_DB: cinashop_finance_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U finance_test -d cinashop_finance_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      TEST_FINANCE_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://finance_test:finance_test@127.0.0.1:5432/cinashop_finance_test
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Execute isolated PostgreSQL 16 ORM and migration catalog audit
        run: npm run audit:orm

      - name: Verify NOT VALID generator semantics on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:orm:not-valid

      - name: Verify sequence generator semantics on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:orm:sequences

      - name: Measure FK statistics candidates on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:work-fk:statistics-scale

      - name: Verify formal shipping indexes and measure isolated read/write costs
        env:
          TMPDIR: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: npm run audit:shipping-lifecycle-capacity

      - name: Preserve complete synthetic shipping plans
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: shipping-index-capacity-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cinashop-shipping-capacity-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  runtime:
    name: workerd runtime tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Audit production dependencies
        run: npm run audit:prod

      - name: Run Workers runtime tests
        run: npm run test:runtime

  frontends:
    name: ${{ matrix.name }} build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Admin
            directory: admin-ts
            command: npm run build
          - name: PC
            directory: pc-ts
            command: npm run build
          - name: Supplier
            directory: supplier-ts
            command: npm run build
          - name: Kefu
            directory: kefu-ts
            command: npm test && npm run build
          - name: UniApp
            directory: uniapp-ts
            command: npm run typecheck && npm run test:toolchain && npm run test:admzip && npm run test:express-qs && npm run test:jest-jsdom-once && npm run test:d3-advisories && npm run build:h5 && npm run build:mp-weixin && npm run build:app && npm run test:build-artifacts && npm run test:automator-qr && npm run test:runtime-i18n
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: view/${{ matrix.directory }}/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install locked Uni dependencies for actual carousel projection
        if: matrix.directory == 'admin-ts'
        working-directory: view/uniapp-ts
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run type, test and build contract
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: ${{ matrix.command }}

      - name: Verify frontend dependency security regressions
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: node --test ../common/toolchain-security.test.mjs

      - name: Audit complete Kefu and PC dependency trees
        if: matrix.directory == 'kefu-ts' || matrix.directory == 'pc-ts'
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: npm audit --audit-level=low --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org

      - name: Verify actual DIY author editors
        if: matrix.directory == 'admin-ts'
        working-directory: view/admin-ts
        run: npm run test:diy-footer && npm run test:diy-presentation && npm run test:diy-customer-service && npm run test:diy-page-settings && npm run test:diy-navigation && npm run test:diy-carousel && npm run test:diy-list && npm run test:diy-state-author && npm run test:diy-follow && npm run test:diy-editorial && npm run test:diy-community && npm run test:diy-promotion && npm run test:diy-coupon && npm run test:diy-points && npm run test:diy-presale && npm run test:diy-combination && npm run test:diy-bargain && npm run test:diy-seckill && npm run test:diy-live-broadcast && npm run test:config-classes && npm run test:browser-log

      - name: Verify editorial author navigation and immutable PHP styles
        if: matrix.directory == 'uniapp-ts'

name: Migration gates (Linux)

on:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: workers-runtime-linux-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Preserve the existing required-check name and fail closed on either dependency.
  worker-static:
    name: Worker type, unit, schema and route gates
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [worker-unit, worker-catalog]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Require both unchanged gate groups to succeed
        env:
          UNIT_RESULT: ${{ needs.worker-unit.result }}
          CATALOG_RESULT: ${{ needs.worker-catalog.result }}
        run: |
          test "$UNIT_RESULT" = "success"
          test "$CATALOG_RESULT" = "success"

  worker-unit:
    name: Worker type, unit, schema and route execution (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Run 39218895760 still recorded passing native cases at the 90-minute
    # job limit (9,197 case passes, no reported assertion failures). Preserve
    # both shards, per-test deadlines and exact zero-skip coverage checks.
    timeout-minutes: 120
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16.14-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: finance_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance_test
          POSTGRES_DB: cinashop_finance_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U finance_test -d cinashop_finance_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      TEST_FINANCE_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://finance_test:finance_test@127.0.0.1:5432/cinashop_finance_test
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Audit production dependencies
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run audit:prod

      # The unit suite bundles real Admin/Supplier auth and Axios code. Frontend
      # build jobs have separate filesystems; both unit shards need each lockfile.
      - name: Install locked Admin dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/admin-ts

      - name: Install locked Supplier dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/supplier-ts

      - name: Install locked Kefu dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/kefu-ts

      - name: Install locked Uni dependencies for customer SFC unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/uniapp-ts

      - name: Run both TypeScript configurations
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Begin isolated native child diagnostic capture
        run: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/audit-native-child-diagnostics.ts --begin

      - name: Run Worker unit tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npm run test:unit -- --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/2 --reporter=verbose --reporter=json --outputFile.json=unit-shard-results.json 2>&1 | tee unit-shard.log

      - name: Audit native child diagnostics including incomplete failed runs
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/audit-native-child-diagnostics.ts

      - name: Preserve unit shard diagnostics even on failure
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: unit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.sha }}
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            workers-ts/unit-shard-results.json
            workers-ts/unit-shard.log
            workers-ts/.cache/native-child-diagnostics/published-*/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Verify exact executed unit shard coverage
        run: node scripts/audit-unit-shards.mjs ${{ matrix.shard }} unit-shard-results.json

      - name: Audit production observability contract
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run audit:observability

      - name: Audit legacy-to-PostgreSQL schema drift
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: |
          npx --no-install tsx scripts/mysql-to-postgres.ts schema-audit --json |
            node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify({source:r.coverage.sourceTableCount,target:r.coverage.targetTableCount,shared:r.coverage.sharedTableCount,sourceGaps:r.coverage.sourceColumnGapTableCount,externalOnly:r.definitionDrift.externalOnlyTables.length,workerOnly:r.definitionDrift.workerOnlyTables.length,columnDrift:r.definitionDrift.columnDrift.length}));})'

      - name: Audit legacy-to-Worker route parity
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: |
          npx --no-install tsx scripts/route-parity-audit.ts |
            node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify({authority:r.phpRoot,...r.totals}));})'

  worker-catalog:
    name: Isolated PostgreSQL 16 migration catalog execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16.14-alpine

        ports:

      - name: Execute isolated PostgreSQL 16 ORM and migration catalog audit
        run: npm run audit:orm

      - name: Verify NOT VALID generator semantics on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:orm:not-valid

        run: npm run audit:orm:sequences

        run: npm run audit:work-fk:statistics-scale

      - name: Verify formal shipping indexes and measure isolated read/write costs

        with:

          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cinashop-shipping-capacity-*.json

  runtime:
